construction.delete: set the strongest leg's most-negative code weight to zero; no other code or match is removed
construction.protection: no additional protection beyond frozen base and threshold gates
construction.tie_break: magnitude desc, match_idx asc, numeric match_id asc; code ties 3 then 1 then 0; source ties fundamental first
construction.weights: exact selected estimator p3/p1/p0 per match, formatted to 12 decimals in output; deleted code zero

eligibility_order: exact N7 and complete estimator row lookup
rank all seven by magnitude desc, match_idx asc, numeric match_id asc
frozen K1/K2/K4/ALL threshold on the ranked prefix

estimator_mapping.CALIBRATED_MARKET_ESTIMATOR: calibrated p/delta/z; derived identity binds target-safe consensus identity
estimator_mapping.FUNDAMENTAL_INDEPENDENT: fundamental p/delta/z; derived identity binds T1 estimator identity
estimator_mapping.LINE_RESIDUAL_MU: same T1 score-distribution probability and signed line residual; derived identity binds T1 estimator identity
estimator_mapping.MODEL_AGREEMENT: require identical favored and omitted codes; weaker magnitude per match; exact tie fundamental first; selected weaker source supplies probability; derived identity binds both agreement components
estimator_mapping.UNION: larger magnitude per match; exact tie fundamental first; selected source supplies probability; derived identity binds both compared component identities

input.estimator_identity: canonical hash of detector/variant, selected source and every immutable estimator component used; UNION/MODEL_AGREEMENT bind both T1 and target-safe consensus identities
input.estimator_rows: one exact estimator_match_freeze row per selected match
input.policy: one exact detector_grid row; DIAGNOSTIC_UNAVAILABLE stays UNAVAILABLE
input.selected_match_ids: exactly seven unique IDs in immutable Stage-1 order
input.stage1_output_sha256: required and copied into every direction output

outcome_boundary: Gate A outcome-unexposed: target result, final/winning SP, payout, tax realization, ROI, settlement, and any post-cutoff evidence are forbidden from X_i, every stage output, fitting inputs, screens, and tie-breaks

upstream_semantics.derived_action: each #193 action is a new Stage-1-conditional identity hash over the adapter, exact #190 policy parameters and support rule
upstream_semantics.source: #190 D_DIRECTION_ONLY is defined only on accepted B0 support

zero_flow.NO_BET: non-N7, failed base/threshold, or unavailable selected-match direction; zero tickets and stake
zero_flow.UNAVAILABLE: upstream policy or estimator row unavailable; zero tickets and stake
zero_flow.never: missing/failed direction is never converted to losing stake or ALLOW_ALL after model choice
